pages.text: Right-click to sit and sneak to dismount. A nearby named mob can sit in an empty seat. Sneak-right-click the seat to release it. An occupied seat can emit full redstone power when chair redstone is enabled.
You can use a seat alone or join two or more into a bench.

pages.title: Backs and Fabrics
pages.text: Right-click with a seat back to attach it. There are five styles. Use carpet on top for the cushion or against the side for a rug. Drill an attachment to remove it. Sneak-drill a side to rotate the seat.
One of five seat back patterns. The frame material may differ from the seat.

pages.title: Joining Seats
pages.text: Sneak-drill the top of one seat, then the top of a directly adjacent seat on the same level. Repeat on the same pair to separate it. Right-click in the air with the drill to clear a selection.
